fields.Name: IT114 - AI Vendor Effort Levels
fields.Description: LIVE-MODEL tier (real model calls cost tokens). Runs the seeded 'IT: Effort Probe' prompt through AIPromptRunner with the model and vendor named by the override and an effort level, recording the HTTP request bodies the driver's SDK sends through fetch in this process. AVE1 (Gemini and Vertex, strict): for each thinking control the cheapest model plus the newest level model, effort 90 sends thinkingConfig and succeeds on the named vendor; a 'minimal' effort never fails the request, a model that rejects it being retried with LOW; completion tokens include Google's thoughtsTokenCount. AVE2 (every other effort-capable driver, survey): one model per driver at effort 90 succeeds and sends an effort field unless the driver is a known gap (#5530); every finding, gaps included, is logged. A model listed in the bundle as known to reject the effort setting it is sent is logged as a gap (none today). A call that fails because the vendor no longer serves the model (404) or the account has no balance or quota is logged and not counted, since it says nothing about the driver. A model is called only when the runner itself finds a credential for it (MJ credential binding, the vendor's default credential, or AI_VENDOR_API_KEY__<DRIVER>); others are logged as skipped, and a check with nothing callable skips loudly. EFFORT_IT_MODELS (comma-separated model names) narrows either check. Requests from SDKs that do not use the global fetch (Bedrock, Azure, Groq, Cerebras, LMStudio) are reported as not observable.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every effort-capable model with a credential accepts an effort level: Gemini and Vertex send thinkingConfig, never fail on an unsupported level and count thinking tokens; other drivers send an effort field unless listed as a known gap.
